item.title: BUMPER GALLERY | Wrexham AFC Women (p) 2-2 Cardiff City Women
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women defeated Cardiff City Women in the Genero Adran Trophy final after a nail-biting penalty shootout in Bangor. Wrexham were playing in the Genero Adran Trophy Final for the first time, but found themselves trailing after just six minutes. The Red Dragons dominated possession and attacking territory, however, and were rewarded in the 25th minute when Josie Smith worked the ball to Ava Suckley, whose long-range chip brought Wrexham level. item.title: COMMUNITY | Mickey Thomas to run the United Airlines NYC Half Marathon
item.description: Club legend Mickey Thomas and a team from the Wrexham AFC Foundation will run the United Airlines New York City Half Marathon next month to raise funds for the Foundation’s twinning partnership with Kick4Life. The 13.2-mile run will take place on Sunday, March 15, and will feature Mickey and a Foundation contingent starting at Prospect Park, running over the Brooklyn Bridge, and through Times Square before finishing in Central Park. item.title: U18 REPORT | Aston Villa 1-0 Wrexham AFC (FA Youth Cup)
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-18s historic FA Youth Cup run came to an end after they were narrowly defeated 1-0 by reigning champions Aston Villa at Keys Park. The young Red Dragons entered the competition at the Third Round, winning 5-1 over Port Vale at the STōK Cae Ras, and they followed that up with a 3-1 away victory over Southend United at Roots Hall to reach the Fifth Round for the first time in the Club's history.
